title: Curated Variant Fastpath with Stability Safeguards
creator: Riya Kapoor
description: Define and implement a ‘Curated Variant Fastpath’ for enterprise customer requests to add new model variants or pin versions with an emphasis on predictable availability, quick canary evaluation, and reversible pin/deprecation windows. The fastpath should allow high-trust partners to request expedited onboarding while preserving platform stability via automated lightweight evals, shadow traffic, and enforced rollback triggers.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Fastpath intake form in Console with required risk signals and sponsor approval link. 2) Automated lightweight eval run (latency, regression on canonical prompts, policy check) completes within 2 hours for variants < 6B. 3) Shadow traffic pipeline configured to route 1-5% traffic for 48 hours by default. 4) Pin operation created with a mutable rollback window and automated metric-based aborts. 5) Docs and runbook published; SE/CS handoff checklist completed.
notes: This ticket scopes the PM work to design the intake, acceptance criteria, and go/no-go signals for the fastpath. Engineering will estimate infra and runtime changes in follow-up ENG tickets. Design will provide mockups for the Console intake flow and the SE handoff screen.
decision_log: 2025-02-12 - Decided to limit automatic fastpath eligibility to contracted enterprise customers with an assigned sponsor to reduce risk. 2025-02-15 - Agreed on default 48h shadow period and 1-5% traffic ramp. 2025-02-18 - Chose lightweight eval suite (latency, top-k token drift, hallucination sentinel prompts) rather than full eval to meet SLO for turnaround time.
implementation_notes: - Intake form fields: model id, variant label, quantization notice, estimated QPS, sponsor, required SLA, data residency note. - Fastpath workflow: intake -> automated eval -> security/policy check -> sponsor approval -> schedule shadow -> monitor metrics -> full rollout or rollback. - Rollback triggers: >10% regression on core prompts OR >2x error rate in structured-output endpoints.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: False negatives in lightweight evals may let a regressive variant pass. Mitigation: Require shadow traffic and metric aborts; if automated signals are inconclusive, block until manual review. Risk: Abuse of fastpath by non-enterprise users. Mitigation: Eligibility gating by account tier + sponsor approval.
next_steps: 1) PM to finalize intake schema and publish PRD (due 2025-02-24). 2) Design to deliver Console mockups (due 2025-02-26). 3) ENG to triage infra work and create ENG tickets for shadow routing, eval infra, and rollback hooks (estimates by 2025-02-28). 4) Draft runbook and SE/CS handoff checklist (draft by 2025-03-03).
